newsitem.title: USA: Cox, U S West Media trade cable systems.
newsitem.headline: Cox, U S West Media trade cable systems.

text.p: Cox Communications Inc and U S West Media Group have completed a previously announced trade of cable systems serving some 97,000 customers, Cox said Friday.

The trade typifies long-term strategies for both companies to form major clusters for the purpose of providing advanced telecommunications services, including voice, video and high-speed data via cable television infrastructure, Cox said.

In the trade, Continental Cablevision, which manages the domestic cable properties of U S West Media, received Cox's cable systems in western Massachusetts and Weymouth, Mass., which are contiguous to Continental's systems in Springfield and Quincy, Mass.
The trade raises the number of Continental cable subscribers in Massachusetts to 830,000, Cox said.
Cox said it received Continental's systems in James City and York County, Va., and Pawtucket, R.I.
The trade was originally announced in April 1996.
U S West Media is part of U S West Inc.
